question.text: Which of the following statements is true for the reaction given below?

options.text: P is a the meso compound 2, 3-butanediol formed by syn-addition
P is a the meso compound 2, 3-butanediol formed by anti-addition
P is a racemic mixture of (d) and (I)  2, 3-butanediol formed by anti-addition
P is a racemic mixture of (d) and (I) 2, 3-butanediol formed by syn-addition

solution.text: Cis-2-butene undergoes hydroxylation by syn-addition forming meso product.
